messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thanks for checking. Your APN settings show an MMSC URL is set, which is good. Since you're abroad and MMS still isn't working, let's check a few more things.

First, please check your network status by using the **check_network_status** action on your phone. This will show me your current network type (2G/3G/4G/5G), signal strength, and whether mobile data and data roaming are enabled on the device. Let me know what it shows.

Oh dear, it says Airplane Mode is ON, no cellular signal or network type is showing, and mobile data and data roaming are both off. That sounds serious. Should I turn off Airplane Mode? Will I lose any photos or information if I do that? I'm a bit worried about accidentally losing anything important.

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
